# 01. setup

**目的**：必要パッケージ、共通関数、分析バージョンを定義する。

```{r c01_setup, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
analysis_version <- "3.3.0"
analysis_run_id <- paste0(
  "continuity_",
  format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
)
analysis_datetime_utc <- format(
  Sys.time(),
  tz = "UTC",
  format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
)

required_packages <- c(
  "readr",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "tibble",
  "stringr",
  "purrr",
  "ggplot2",
  "sf",
  "spdep",
  "cluster",
  "DBI",
  "RSQLite"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "次のRパッケージを先にインストールしてください: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

if (utils::packageVersion("spdep") < base::numeric_version("1.2-7")) {
  stop(
    "spdep >= 1.2-7 が必要です。現在のversion: ",
    as.character(utils::packageVersion("spdep"))
  )
}

clamp01 <- function(x) {
  pmax(0, pmin(1, x))
}

safe_name <- function(x) {
  x |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_") |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("_+", "_") |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
}

write_gpkg_layer_safe <- function(x, dsn, layer) {
  if (!inherits(x, "sf")) {
    stop("GPKG出力対象がsfではありません: ", layer)
  }

  if (nrow(x) == 0) {
    warning("0件のためGPKGレイヤ出力をスキップします: ", layer)
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }

  dir.create(dirname(dsn), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  if (file.exists(dsn)) {
    existing_layers <- sf::st_layers(dsn)$name
    if (layer %in% existing_layers) {
      sf::st_delete(dsn, layer = layer, quiet = TRUE)
    }
  }

  sf::st_write(
    x,
    dsn = dsn,
    layer = layer,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  invisible(TRUE)
}

write_gpkg_attribute_table <- function(df, dsn, table_name, description = "") {
  if (!file.exists(dsn)) {
    warning("GPKGがまだ存在しないため属性テーブルをスキップします: ", table_name)
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }

  con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), dsn)
  on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(con), add = TRUE)

  DBI::dbWriteTable(
    con,
    table_name,
    as.data.frame(df),
    overwrite = TRUE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "gpkg_contents")) {
    DBI::dbExecute(
      con,
      "DELETE FROM gpkg_contents WHERE table_name = ?",
      params = list(table_name)
    )

    DBI::dbExecute(
      con,
      paste(
        "INSERT INTO gpkg_contents",
        "(table_name, data_type, identifier, description, last_change, srs_id)",
        "VALUES (?, 'attributes', ?, ?, ?, NULL)"
      ),
      params = list(
        table_name,
        table_name,
        description,
        analysis_datetime_utc
      )
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

make_empty_point_sf <- function(crs_value = 4326) {
  sf::st_sf(
    geometry = sf::st_sfc(crs = crs_value)
  )
}
```

# 02. paths-and-parameters

**目的**：地形分類・W07水系属性付与済みCSV、時系列、感度分析、空間分析、出力先を定義する。

```{r c02_paths_and_parameters, eval=TRUE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# INPUT
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tokyo固有のactivity-domain前処理済みCSVを正式入力とする。
# このCSVは GSI地形分類 + W07水系 + activity-domain phase flags を含む。
input_csv <- "13Tokyo_chronology_gsi_landform_activity.csv"

results_dir <- "Continuity_results_v3_3"
csv_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "csv")
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figure")
gpkg_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "gpkg")
continuity_gpkg <- file.path(gpkg_dir, "Continuity.gpkg")

for (d in c(results_dir, csv_dir, figure_dir, gpkg_dir)) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# TIME SERIES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
phase_cols <- c("Pa", "Jo", "Ya", "Ko", "Na", "He", "Me")

chronology_marker_cols_candidate <- c(
  "Pa", "Jo", "Ya", "Ko", "As", "An", "Na", "He", "Me",
  "Ka", "Nb", "Mu", "Se", "EM", "AM", "Ed", "Md", "Pr", "Un"
)

exclude_em_only <- TRUE
em_col <- "EM"

phase_label_table <- tibble::tibble(
  phase_code = phase_cols,
  phase_order = seq_along(phase_cols),
  phase_label_ja = c(
    "旧石器", "縄文", "弥生", "古墳", "奈良", "平安", "中世"
  ),
  phase_label_en = c(
    "Palaeolithic", "Jomon", "Yayoi", "Kofun", "Nara", "Heian", "Medieval"
  )
)

preferred_id_col <- "JASID"
lon_col <- "Lon"
lat_col <- "Lat"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# CONTINUITY INDEX WEIGHT SENSITIVITY
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 実年代幅によるtime weightingは行わない。
continuity_weight_sets <- tibble::tribble(
  ~weight_set,       ~w_presence, ~w_run, ~w_gapfree,
  "baseline",               0.35,   0.40,       0.25,
  "balanced",               1/3,    1/3,        1/3,
  "coverage_heavy",         0.50,   0.30,       0.20,
  "run_heavy",              0.25,   0.55,       0.20,
  "gap_span_heavy",         0.30,   0.30,       0.40
)

baseline_weight_set <- "baseline"
continuity_top_fraction <- 0.10

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# SEQUENCE CLUSTERING
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
cluster_k_candidates <- 2:10
cluster_k_manual <- NA_integer_
cluster_stability_repeats <- 50L
cluster_stability_fraction <- 0.80
dominant_cluster_share_threshold <- 0.50
subcluster_k_candidates <- 2:6
sequence_cluster_seed <- 20260809L

sequence_class_levels <- c(
  "no_presence",
  "single_phase",
  "continuous_2phase",
  "continuous_3_4phase",
  "continuous_5_7phase",
  "intermittent_gap1",
  "intermittent_gap2plus",
  "unclassified"
)

transition_levels <- c("continue", "drop", "new")
markov_state_levels <- c("apparent_absence", "presence")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# CHANGE-POINT SCREENING
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
change_point_min_segment <- 2L
landscape_min_places <- 20L

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# SPATIAL ANALYSIS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
spatial_analysis_crs <- 6677L
spatial_k_values <- c(4L, 8L, 12L)
spatial_primary_k <- 8L
spatial_alpha <- 0.05
spatial_seed <- 20260809L
spatial_permutations <- 999L

spatial_continuous_metrics <- c(
  "continuity_index",
  "longest_run_length",
  "gap_count",
  "max_gap_length",
  "intermittency_index"
)

spatial_transition_global_events <- c("continue", "drop", "new")
spatial_transition_binary_events <- c("drop", "new")

run_fixed_distance_calibration <- TRUE
fixed_distance_bands_m <- c(1000, 2000, 5000)
edge_diagnostic_thresholds_m <- c(2000, 5000)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# STANDARDIZED ACTIVITY DOMAINS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# SiteType/ArchaeologicalFeaturesの意味解釈はTokyo前処理Rmdで完了済み。
# 共通分析ではphase-specific flagを唯一のactivity-domain判定根拠とする。
activity_domains <- c(
  "all_land_use",
  "general_activity",
  "monument",
  "institutional",
  "production"
)

activity_domain_flag_map <- c(
  general_activity = "activity_general_activity",
  monument = "activity_monument",
  institutional = "activity_institutional",
  production = "activity_production"
)

activity_phase_flag_map <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(
    names(activity_domain_flag_map),
    function(domain_name) {
      stats::setNames(
        paste0(
          "activity_",
          domain_name,
          "_",
          phase_cols
        ),
        phase_cols
      )
    }
  ),
  names(activity_domain_flag_map)
)

activity_phase_flag_cols <- unname(
  unlist(
    activity_phase_flag_map
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# GSI / W07 CONTEXT COLUMNS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
landform_cols_candidate <- c(
  "gsi_landform_code",
  "gsi_landform_class",
  "gsi_landform_match_status",
  "gsi_landform_zoom",
  "gsi_landform_source"
)

watershed_cols_candidate <- c(
  "watershed_mesh_code_100m",
  "watershed_first_mesh_code",
  "watersystem_code",
  "watersystem_name",
  "river_code",
  "river_name",
  "unit_basin_code",
  "w07_match_status",
  "w07_source_year",
  "w07_source_id"
)

metadata_cols_candidate <- c(
  "JASID", "LGC", "Site_no", "SiteName_furigana", "SiteName_original",
  "Address", "Chronology", "SiteType", "ArchaeologicalFeatures",
  "MajorArtefacts", "Lon", "Lat",
  landform_cols_candidate,
  watershed_cols_candidate,
  unname(activity_domain_flag_map),
  activity_phase_flag_cols
)

cat("input_csv:", input_csv, "\n")
cat("phase order:", paste(phase_cols, collapse = " -> "), "\n")
cat("activity domains:", paste(activity_domains, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("continuity weight sets:", paste(continuity_weight_sets$weight_set, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("sequence k candidates:", paste(cluster_k_candidates, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("spatial k values:", paste(spatial_k_values, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("fixed-distance calibration:", run_fixed_distance_calibration, "\n")
cat("results_dir:", results_dir, "\n")
```

# 03. read-input-schema-coordinate-qa

**目的**：入力CSVを読み込み、座標欠損・不正値を最初に検出して全分析から除外し、GSI/W07属性の可用性を診断する。

```{r c03_read_input_schema_coordinate_qa, eval=TRUE}
if (!file.exists(input_csv)) {
  stop("入力CSVが見つかりません: ", input_csv)
}

chronology_input_all <- readr::read_csv(
  input_csv,
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = readr::locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) |>
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::matches("^Unnamed:"))

missing_phase_cols <- setdiff(phase_cols, names(chronology_input_all))
if (length(missing_phase_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "入力CSVに解析対象列がありません: ",
    paste(missing_phase_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (!preferred_id_col %in% names(chronology_input_all)) {
  chronology_input_all[[preferred_id_col]] <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(chronology_input_all)))
}

if (!all(c(lon_col, lat_col) %in% names(chronology_input_all))) {
  stop("Lon/Lat列がないため、次版分析仕様を実行できません。")
}

chronology_input_all <- chronology_input_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    place_id = as.character(.data[[preferred_id_col]]),
    lon_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[lon_col]])),
    lat_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[lat_col]])),
    coordinate_status = dplyr::case_when(
      !nzchar(trimws(dplyr::coalesce(as.character(.data[[lon_col]]), ""))) &
        !nzchar(trimws(dplyr::coalesce(as.character(.data[[lat_col]]), ""))) ~ "missing_both",
      !nzchar(trimws(dplyr::coalesce(as.character(.data[[lon_col]]), ""))) ~ "missing_lon",
      !nzchar(trimws(dplyr::coalesce(as.character(.data[[lat_col]]), ""))) ~ "missing_lat",
      !is.finite(lon_value) | !is.finite(lat_value) ~ "non_numeric",
      lon_value < -180 | lon_value > 180 | lat_value < -90 | lat_value > 90 ~ "out_of_range",
      TRUE ~ "valid"
    ),
    coordinate_valid = coordinate_status == "valid"
  )

coordinate_quality_summary <- chronology_input_all |>
  dplyr::count(coordinate_status, name = "n_rows") |>
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = n_rows / sum(n_rows))

coordinate_excluded_points <- chronology_input_all |>
  dplyr::filter(!coordinate_valid) |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id,
    dplyr::any_of(c("SiteName_original", "Address", lon_col, lat_col)),
    coordinate_status
  )

readr::write_csv(
  coordinate_quality_summary,
  file.path(csv_dir, "coordinate_quality_summary.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  coordinate_excluded_points,
  file.path(csv_dir, "coordinate_excluded_points.csv")
)

# 座標不正地点は時系列・空間の全分析から除外し、母集団を統一する。
chronology_coordinate_valid <- chronology_input_all |>
  dplyr::filter(coordinate_valid)

# GSI / W07 QA
context_field_status <- tibble::tibble(
  column_name = c(landform_cols_candidate, watershed_cols_candidate),
  exists = column_name %in% names(chronology_input_all),
  context_group = c(
    rep("GSI_landform", length(landform_cols_candidate)),
    rep("W07_watershed", length(watershed_cols_candidate))
  )
)

context_match_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  if ("gsi_landform_match_status" %in% names(chronology_coordinate_valid)) {
    chronology_coordinate_valid |>
      dplyr::count(gsi_landform_match_status, name = "n_rows") |>
      dplyr::mutate(context = "GSI_landform") |>
      dplyr::rename(status = gsi_landform_match_status)
  } else {
    tibble::tibble(context = "GSI_landform", status = "column_missing", n_rows = nrow(chronology_coordinate_valid))
  },
  if ("w07_match_status" %in% names(chronology_coordinate_valid)) {
    chronology_coordinate_valid |>
      dplyr::count(w07_match_status, name = "n_rows") |>
      dplyr::mutate(context = "W07_watershed") |>
      dplyr::rename(status = w07_match_status)
  } else {
    tibble::tibble(context = "W07_watershed", status = "column_missing", n_rows = nrow(chronology_coordinate_valid))
  }
)

readr::write_csv(
  context_field_status,
  file.path(csv_dir, "context_field_status.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  context_match_summary,
  file.path(csv_dir, "context_match_summary.csv")
)

print(coordinate_quality_summary)
print(context_match_summary)
```

# 04. exclude-em-only-and-build-context

**目的**：座標有効地点からEMのみ地点を除外し、地形・水系から自然地理的な集計単位を構築する。activity domainはTokyo前処理Rmdが付与したphase-specific flagを読み込む。

```{r c04_exclude_em_only_and_build_context, eval=TRUE}
chronology_marker_cols <- intersect(
  chronology_marker_cols_candidate,
  names(chronology_coordinate_valid)
)

if (exclude_em_only && em_col %in% chronology_marker_cols) {
  marker_numeric <- chronology_coordinate_valid |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(chronology_marker_cols)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::everything(),
        ~ tidyr::replace_na(
          suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(.x))),
          0
        )
      )
    )

  other_marker_cols <- setdiff(
    chronology_marker_cols,
    em_col
  )

  em_only_flag <- marker_numeric[[em_col]] > 0 &
    rowSums(
      marker_numeric[
        ,
        other_marker_cols,
        drop = FALSE
      ] > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) == 0
} else {
  em_only_flag <- rep(
    FALSE,
    nrow(chronology_coordinate_valid)
  )
}

em_only_exclusion_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  item = c(
    "input_rows_total",
    "excluded_invalid_coordinate_rows",
    "coordinate_valid_rows",
    "excluded_em_only_rows",
    "analysis_rows_final"
  ),
  n_rows = c(
    nrow(chronology_input_all),
    nrow(coordinate_excluded_points),
    nrow(chronology_coordinate_valid),
    sum(em_only_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(!em_only_flag, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  em_only_exclusion_summary,
  file.path(
    csv_dir,
    "analysis_population_summary.csv"
  )
)

chronology_raw <- chronology_coordinate_valid |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !em_only_flag
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    place_id = as.character(
      .data[[preferred_id_col]]
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 自然地理的な分節単位
# ------------------------------------------------------------
for (nm in unique(c(
  "watersystem_code",
  "watersystem_name",
  "unit_basin_code",
  "gsi_landform_code",
  "gsi_landform_class"
))) {
  if (!nm %in% names(chronology_raw)) {
    chronology_raw[[nm]] <- NA_character_
  }
}

has_watersystem <- all(
  c(
    "watersystem_code",
    "watersystem_name"
  ) %in% names(chronology_raw)
)

has_unit_basin <- all(
  c(
    "watersystem_code",
    "unit_basin_code"
  ) %in% names(chronology_raw)
)

has_landform <- all(
  c(
    "gsi_landform_code",
    "gsi_landform_class"
  ) %in% names(chronology_raw)
)

chronology_raw <- chronology_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    watersystem_unit_id = dplyr::if_else(
      has_watersystem &
        !is.na(.data[["watersystem_code"]]) &
        nzchar(.data[["watersystem_code"]]),
      paste0(
        "WS_",
        .data[["watersystem_code"]]
      ),
      NA_character_
    ),
    watersystem_unit_label = dplyr::if_else(
      has_watersystem &
        !is.na(.data[["watersystem_name"]]) &
        nzchar(.data[["watersystem_name"]]),
      paste0(
        .data[["watersystem_code"]],
        " / ",
        .data[["watersystem_name"]]
      ),
      NA_character_
    ),
    basin_unit_id = dplyr::if_else(
      has_unit_basin &
        !is.na(.data[["watersystem_code"]]) &
        !is.na(.data[["unit_basin_code"]]) &
        nzchar(.data[["watersystem_code"]]) &
        nzchar(.data[["unit_basin_code"]]),
      paste0(
        "B_",
        .data[["watersystem_code"]],
        "_",
        .data[["unit_basin_code"]]
      ),
      NA_character_
    ),
    basin_unit_label = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(basin_unit_id),
      paste0(
        dplyr::coalesce(
          .data[["watersystem_name"]],
          "unknown"
        ),
        " / basin ",
        .data[["unit_basin_code"]]
      ),
      NA_character_
    ),
    landscape_unit_id = dplyr::if_else(
      has_unit_basin &
        has_landform &
        !is.na(basin_unit_id) &
        !is.na(.data[["gsi_landform_code"]]) &
        nzchar(.data[["gsi_landform_code"]]),
      paste0(
        basin_unit_id,
        "_LF_",
        safe_name(
          .data[["gsi_landform_code"]]
        )
      ),
      NA_character_
    ),
    landscape_unit_label = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(landscape_unit_id),
      paste0(
        dplyr::coalesce(
          basin_unit_label,
          "unknown basin"
        ),
        " / ",
        dplyr::coalesce(
          .data[["gsi_landform_class"]],
          "unknown landform"
        )
      ),
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# activity-domain availability
# ------------------------------------------------------------
activity_domain_availability <- tibble::tibble(
  activity_domain = activity_domains,
  phase_specific_available = c(
    TRUE,
    vapply(
      names(activity_phase_flag_map),
      function(domain_name) {
        all(
          unname(
            activity_phase_flag_map[[domain_name]]
          ) %in% names(chronology_raw)
        )
      },
      logical(1)
    )
  ),
  place_flag_available = c(
    TRUE,
    unname(
      activity_domain_flag_map
    ) %in% names(chronology_raw)
  )
)

missing_activity_phase_cols <- setdiff(
  activity_phase_flag_cols,
  names(chronology_raw)
)

if (length(missing_activity_phase_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "activity-domain前処理済みCSVに必要なphase-specific flagがありません: ",
    paste(
      missing_activity_phase_cols,
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "\n先に Tokyo_activity_domain_preprocess.Rmd を実行してください。"
  )
}

# place-level membershipはphase-specific flagから再構築する。
# all_land_useは分析母集団の全地点を保持する。
place_activity_domain <- chronology_raw |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    place_id,
    activity_domain = "all_land_use"
  )

for (domain_name in names(activity_phase_flag_map)) {
  flag_cols <- unname(
    activity_phase_flag_map[[domain_name]]
  )

  flag_matrix <- chronology_raw |>
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(flag_cols)
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::everything(),
        ~ tidyr::replace_na(
          suppressWarnings(
            readr::parse_number(
              as.character(.x)
            )
          ),
          0
        )
      )
    )

  any_domain <- rowSums(
    as.matrix(flag_matrix) > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) > 0

  place_activity_domain <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    place_activity_domain,
    chronology_raw |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        place_id,
        activity_domain = dplyr::if_else(
          any_domain,
          domain_name,
          NA_character_
        )
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(activity_domain)
      )
  )
}

place_activity_domain <- place_activity_domain |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    place_id,
    activity_domain
  )

metadata_cols <- intersect(
  metadata_cols_candidate,
  names(chronology_raw)
)

context_cols <- intersect(
  c(
    "watersystem_unit_id",
    "watersystem_unit_label",
    "basin_unit_id",
    "basin_unit_label",
    "landscape_unit_id",
    "landscape_unit_label"
  ),
  names(chronology_raw)
)

analysis_metadata_cols <- unique(
  c(
    setdiff(
      metadata_cols,
      c(
        "place_id",
        phase_cols
      )
    ),
    context_cols
  )
)

landscape_unit_overview <- dplyr::bind_rows(
```

# 06. build-place-phase-tables

**目的**：7時期をpresence/apparent_absenceの地点系列に変換し、7bit系列を文字列として保持する。

```{r c06_build_place_phase_tables, eval=TRUE}
format_sequence_phases <- function(sequence_string_value) {
  s <- stringr::str_pad(
    as.character(sequence_string_value),
    width = length(phase_cols),
    side = "left",
    pad = "0"
  )

  chars <- strsplit(
    s,
    "",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1]]

  active_phases <- phase_cols[
    chars == "1"
  ]

  if (length(active_phases) == 0) {
    return("none")
  }

  paste(
    active_phases,
    collapse = "-"
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# all_land_use: original chronology

phase_value_table <- chronology_raw |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id,
    dplyr::any_of(
      analysis_metadata_cols
    ),
    dplyr::all_of(
      phase_cols
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(
        phase_cols
      ),
      ~ tidyr::replace_na(
        suppressWarnings(
          readr::parse_number(
            as.character(.x)
          )
        ),
        0
      )
    )
  )

place_phase_long <- phase_value_table |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(
      phase_cols
    ),
    names_to = "phase_code",
    values_to = "phase_value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    chronology_phase_table,
    by = "phase_code"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    presence = as.integer(
      phase_value > 0
    ),
    presence_status = dplyr::if_else(
      presence == 1L,
      "presence",
      "apparent_absence"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    place_id,
    phase_order
  )

place_phase_sequence_wide <- place_phase_long |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id,
    phase_code,
    presence
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = phase_code,
    values_from = presence,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    phase_value_table |>
      dplyr::select(
        place_id,
        dplyr::any_of(
          analysis_metadata_cols
        )
      ),
    by = "place_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    place_id
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sequence_string_7digit = do.call(
      paste0,
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(

        )
      )
    ),
    sequence_string_7digit = as.character(
      sequence_string_7digit
    ),
    sequence_display = paste0(
      "seq_",
      sequence_string_7digit
    ),
    sequence_phases = vapply(
      sequence_string_7digit,
      format_sequence_phases,
      character(1)
    )
  )
```

# 07. run-length-analysis

**目的**：地点ごとの連続出現区間を抽出する。

```{r c07_run_length_analysis, eval=TRUE}
extract_runs_one <- function(place_df) {
  place_df <- place_df |>
    dplyr::arrange(phase_order)

  v <- place_df$presence
  r <- rle(v == 1L)
  ends <- cumsum(r$lengths)
  starts <- ends - r$lengths + 1L
  run_idx <- which(r$values)

  if (length(run_idx) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      place_id = character(0),
      run_id = character(0),
      run_index = integer(0),
      run_start_phase = character(0),
      run_end_phase = character(0),
      run_start_order = integer(0),
      run_end_order = integer(0),
      run_length = integer(0)
    ))
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    place_id = place_df$place_id[1],
    run_index = seq_along(run_idx),
    run_start_pos = starts[run_idx],
    run_end_pos = ends[run_idx]
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      run_id = paste0(place_id, "_R", run_index),
      run_start_phase = place_df$phase_code[run_start_pos],
      run_end_phase = place_df$phase_code[run_end_pos],
      run_start_order = place_df$phase_order[run_start_pos],
      run_end_order = place_df$phase_order[run_end_pos],
      run_length = run_end_order - run_start_order + 1L
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      place_id, run_id, run_index,
      run_start_phase, run_end_phase,
      run_start_order, run_end_order, run_length
    )
}

place_run_events <- place_phase_long |>
  dplyr::group_split(place_id) |>
  purrr::map_dfr(extract_runs_one)

readr::write_csv(
  place_run_events,
  file.path(csv_dir, "place_run_events.csv")
)
```

# 08. gap-analysis

**目的**：presence run間の内部的なapparent_absence区間を抽出する。

```{r c08_gap_analysis, eval=TRUE}
extract_gaps_one <- function(run_df) {
  run_df <- run_df |>
    dplyr::arrange(run_start_order)

  if (nrow(run_df) < 2) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      place_id = character(0),
      gap_id = character(0),
      gap_index = integer(0),
      gap_start_order = integer(0),
      gap_end_order = integer(0),
      gap_length = integer(0),
      between_run_from = character(0),
      between_run_to = character(0)
    ))
  }

  out <- vector("list", nrow(run_df) - 1L)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(run_df) - 1L)) {
    gap_start <- run_df$run_end_order[i] + 1L
    gap_end <- run_df$run_start_order[i + 1L] - 1L
    gap_length <- gap_end - gap_start + 1L

    if (gap_length > 0) {
      out[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
        place_id = run_df$place_id[1],
        gap_index = i,
        gap_id = paste0(run_df$place_id[1], "_G", i),
        gap_start_order = gap_start,
        gap_end_order = gap_end,
        gap_length = gap_length,
        between_run_from = run_df$run_id[i],
        between_run_to = run_df$run_id[i + 1L]
      )
    }
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}

place_gap_events <- place_run_events |>
  dplyr::group_split(place_id) |>
  purrr::map_dfr(extract_gaps_one) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    chronology_phase_table |>
      dplyr::select(gap_start_order = phase_order, gap_start_phase = phase_code),
    by = "gap_start_order"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    chronology_phase_table |>
      dplyr::select(gap_end_order = phase_order, gap_end_phase = phase_code),
    by = "gap_end_order"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id, gap_id, gap_index,
    gap_start_phase, gap_end_phase,
    gap_start_order, gap_end_order,
    gap_length, between_run_from, between_run_to
  )

readr::write_csv(
  place_gap_events,
  file.path(csv_dir, "place_gap_events.csv")
)
```

# 09. continuity-index-sensitivity-and-sequence-class

**目的**：地点別の基本Run/Gap指標、sequence class、continuity indexを作成し、複数の重みセットに対する順位・上位地点の頑健性を評価する。

```{r c09_continuity_index_sensitivity_and_sequence_class, eval=TRUE}
phase_n <- length(phase_cols)

sequence_class_definition <- tibble::tibble(
  sequence_class_code = c(0L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L, 6L),
  sequence_class = c(
    "no_presence",
    "single_phase",
    "continuous_2phase",
    "continuous_3_4phase",
    "continuous_5_7phase",
    "intermittent_gap1",
    "intermittent_gap2plus"
  ),
  criterion = c(
    "presence_phase_count == 0",
    "presence_phase_count == 1",
    "gap_count == 0 and longest_run_length == 2",
    "gap_count == 0 and longest_run_length is 3 or 4",
    "gap_count == 0 and longest_run_length is 5 to 7",
    "gap_count == 1",
    "gap_count >= 2"
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  sequence_class_definition,
  file.path(csv_dir, "sequence_class_definition.csv")
)

basic_presence_summary <- place_phase_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(place_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    presence_phase_count = sum(presence, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_presence_order = ifelse(
      presence_phase_count > 0,
      min(phase_order[presence == 1L], na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    last_presence_order = ifelse(
      presence_phase_count > 0,
      max(phase_order[presence == 1L], na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    observed_span_phase_count = ifelse(
      presence_phase_count > 0,
      last_presence_order - first_presence_order + 1L,
      0L
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

run_summary <- place_run_events |>
  dplyr::group_by(place_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    run_count = dplyr::n(),
    longest_run_length = max(run_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_run_length = mean(run_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gap_summary <- place_gap_events |>
  dplyr::group_by(place_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    gap_count = dplyr::n(),
    gap_phase_count = sum(gap_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_gap_length = max(gap_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gap_length = mean(gap_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

place_continuity_base <- basic_presence_summary |>
  dplyr::left_join(run_summary, by = "place_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(gap_summary, by = "place_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    chronology_phase_table |>
      dplyr::select(first_presence_order = phase_order, first_presence_phase = phase_code),
    by = "first_presence_order"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    chronology_phase_table |>
      dplyr::select(last_presence_order = phase_order, last_presence_phase = phase_code),
    by = "last_presence_order"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    run_count = tidyr::replace_na(run_count, 0L),
    longest_run_length = tidyr::replace_na(longest_run_length, 0),
    mean_run_length = tidyr::replace_na(mean_run_length, 0),
    gap_count = tidyr::replace_na(gap_count, 0L),
    gap_phase_count = tidyr::replace_na(gap_phase_count, 0),
    max_gap_length = tidyr::replace_na(max_gap_length, 0),
    mean_gap_length = tidyr::replace_na(mean_gap_length, 0),
    presence_density_in_span = dplyr::if_else(
      observed_span_phase_count > 0,
      presence_phase_count / observed_span_phase_count,
      0
    ),
    presence_ratio_all_phases = presence_phase_count / phase_n,
    longest_run_ratio_all_phases = longest_run_length / phase_n,
    observed_span_ratio_all_phases = observed_span_phase_count / phase_n,
    gap_penalty = dplyr::if_else(
      observed_span_phase_count > 1,
      gap_phase_count / (observed_span_phase_count - 1),
      0
    ),
    gap_free_span_component = observed_span_ratio_all_phases *
      (1 - clamp01(gap_penalty)),
    intermittency_index = dplyr::if_else(
      presence_phase_count <= 1,
      0,
      clamp01(gap_penalty)
    ),
    sequence_class_code = dplyr::case_when(
      presence_phase_count == 0 ~ 0L,
      presence_phase_count == 1 ~ 1L,
      gap_count == 0 & longest_run_length == 2 ~ 2L,
      gap_count == 0 & longest_run_length %in% 3:4 ~ 3L,
      gap_count == 0 & longest_run_length >= 5 ~ 4L,
      gap_count == 1 ~ 5L,
      gap_count >= 2 ~ 6L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    sequence_class = dplyr::case_when(
      sequence_class_code == 0L ~ "no_presence",
      sequence_class_code == 1L ~ "single_phase",
      sequence_class_code == 2L ~ "continuous_2phase",
      sequence_class_code == 3L ~ "continuous_3_4phase",
      sequence_class_code == 4L ~ "continuous_5_7phase",
      sequence_class_code == 5L ~ "intermittent_gap1",
      sequence_class_code == 6L ~ "intermittent_gap2plus",
      TRUE ~ "unclassified"
    ),
    sequence_class = factor(sequence_class, levels = sequence_class_levels)
  )

continuity_weight_scores <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  continuity_weight_sets,
  function(weight_set, w_presence, w_run, w_gapfree) {
    place_continuity_base |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        place_id,
        weight_set,
        w_presence,
        w_run,
        w_gapfree,
        continuity_index = dplyr::if_else(
          presence_phase_count == 0,
          0,
          clamp01(
            w_presence * presence_ratio_all_phases +
              w_run * longest_run_ratio_all_phases +
              w_gapfree * gap_free_span_component
          )
        )
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(continuity_index), place_id) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        rank_desc = dplyr::min_rank(dplyr::desc(continuity_index)),
        top_n = max(1L, ceiling(dplyr::n() * continuity_top_fraction)),
        top_fraction_flag = rank_desc <= top_n
      )
  }
)

baseline_weight_scores <- continuity_weight_scores |>
  dplyr::filter(weight_set == baseline_weight_set) |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id,
    baseline_continuity_index = continuity_index,
    baseline_rank = rank_desc,
    baseline_top = top_fraction_flag
  )

continuity_weight_robustness <- continuity_weight_scores |>
  dplyr::left_join(baseline_weight_scores, by = "place_id") |>
  dplyr::group_by(weight_set) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    spearman_rank_vs_baseline = suppressWarnings(
      stats::cor(rank_desc, baseline_rank, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
    ),
    top_baseline_n = sum(baseline_top, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_current_n = sum(top_fraction_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_intersection_n = sum(baseline_top & top_fraction_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_union_n = sum(baseline_top | top_fraction_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_jaccard_vs_baseline = dplyr::if_else(
      top_union_n > 0,
      top_intersection_n / top_union_n,
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

continuity_weight_place_sensitivity <- continuity_weight_scores |>
  dplyr::group_by(place_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    continuity_weight_mean = mean(continuity_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    continuity_weight_sd = stats::sd(continuity_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    continuity_weight_min = min(continuity_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    continuity_weight_max = max(continuity_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    continuity_weight_range = continuity_weight_max - continuity_weight_min,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

place_continuity_summary <- place_continuity_base |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    baseline_weight_scores |>
      dplyr::select(
        place_id,
        continuity_index = baseline_continuity_index,
        continuity_rank = baseline_rank
      ),
    by = "place_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    continuity_weight_place_sensitivity,
    by = "place_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    place_phase_sequence_wide |>
      dplyr::select(
        place_id,
        sequence_string_7digit,
        sequence_display,
        sequence_phases,
        dplyr::any_of(analysis_metadata_cols)
      ),
    by = "place_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    place_id,
    dplyr::any_of(analysis_metadata_cols),
    sequence_string_7digit,
    sequence_display,
    sequence_phases,
    sequence_class_code,
    sequence_class,
    continuity_index,
    continuity_rank
  )

readr::write_csv(
  continuity_weight_scores,

readr::write_csv(
  continuity_weight_robustness,
  file.path(csv_dir, "continuity_weight_robustness.csv")
```

# 10. run-gap-by-activity-and-landscape

**目的**：Run/Gapと継続性指標を、標準化activity domainおよび水系・単位流域・水系×地形単位で比較する。

```{r c10_run_gap_by_activity_and_landscape, eval=TRUE}
calculate_domain_place_metrics <- function(domain_place_df) {
  domain_place_df <- domain_place_df |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      phase_order
    )

  v <- as.integer(
    domain_place_df$presence
  )

  unresolved_count <- sum(
    is.na(v)
  )

  confirmed_presence_count <- sum(
    v == 1L,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # Run/Gap/continuityは7期すべての状態が確定している系列だけで計算する。
  # NAを0に置換してgap/dropを人工的に作らない。
  if (unresolved_count > 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        place_id = domain_place_df$place_id[[1]],
        activity_domain = domain_place_df$activity_domain[[1]],
        sequence_resolution = "temporally_unresolved",
        unresolved_phase_count = unresolved_count,
        confirmed_presence_phase_count = confirmed_presence_count,
        presence_phase_count = NA_integer_,
        run_count = NA_integer_,
        longest_run_length = NA_integer_,
        mean_run_length = NA_real_,
        gap_count = NA_integer_,
        gap_phase_count = NA_integer_,
        max_gap_length = NA_integer_,
        mean_gap_length = NA_real_,
        observed_span_phase_count = NA_integer_,
        continuity_index = NA_real_,
        intermittency_index = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  presence_idx <- which(
    v == 1L
  )

  if (length(presence_idx) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        place_id = domain_place_df$place_id[[1]],
        activity_domain = domain_place_df$activity_domain[[1]],
        sequence_resolution = "resolved",
        unresolved_phase_count = 0L,
        confirmed_presence_phase_count = 0L,
        presence_phase_count = 0L,
        run_count = 0L,
        longest_run_length = 0L,
        mean_run_length = 0,
        gap_count = 0L,
        gap_phase_count = 0L,
        max_gap_length = 0L,
        mean_gap_length = 0,
        observed_span_phase_count = 0L,
        continuity_index = 0,
        intermittency_index = 0
      )
    )
  }

  rr <- rle(
    v == 1L
  )

  run_lengths <- rr$lengths[
    rr$values
  ]

  first_pos <- min(
    presence_idx
  )

  last_pos <- max(
    presence_idx
  )

  observed_span <- last_pos - first_pos + 1L

  gap_phase_count <- sum(
    v[first_pos:last_pos] == 0L
  )

  gap_rr <- rle(
    v[first_pos:last_pos] == 0L
  )

  gap_lengths <- gap_rr$lengths[
    gap_rr$values
  ]

  gap_count <- length(
    gap_lengths
  )

  presence_phase_count <- sum(
    v
  )

  longest_run <- max(
    run_lengths
  )

  gap_penalty <- if (
    observed_span > 1L
  ) {
    gap_phase_count /
      (observed_span - 1L)
  } else {
    0
  }

  gap_free_span_component <-
    (observed_span / length(phase_cols)) *
    (1 - clamp01(gap_penalty))

  baseline_weights <- continuity_weight_sets |>
    dplyr::filter(
      weight_set == baseline_weight_set
    )

  continuity_index <- clamp01(
    baseline_weights$w_presence[[1]] *
      (presence_phase_count / length(phase_cols)) +
      baseline_weights$w_run[[1]] *
      (longest_run / length(phase_cols)) +
      baseline_weights$w_gapfree[[1]] *
      gap_free_span_component
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    place_id = domain_place_df$place_id[[1]],
    activity_domain = domain_place_df$activity_domain[[1]],
    sequence_resolution = "resolved",
    unresolved_phase_count = 0L,
    confirmed_presence_phase_count = confirmed_presence_count,
    presence_phase_count = presence_phase_count,
    run_count = length(run_lengths),
    longest_run_length = longest_run,
    mean_run_length = mean(run_lengths),
    gap_count = gap_count,
    gap_phase_count = gap_phase_count,
    max_gap_length = ifelse(
      gap_count > 0,
      max(gap_lengths),
      0
    ),
    mean_gap_length = ifelse(
      gap_count > 0,
      mean(gap_lengths),
      0
    ),
    observed_span_phase_count = observed_span,
    continuity_index = continuity_index,
    intermittency_index = dplyr::if_else(
      presence_phase_count <= 1,
      0,
      clamp01(
        gap_penalty
      )
    )
  )
}
```

# 11. sequence-clustering-stability

**目的**：7bit系列のJaccardクラスタリングについてkを固定せず、silhouette・頻度重み付きsilhouette・subsample安定性を評価し、巨大クラスタ内部の再クラスタリングも診断する。

```{r c11_sequence_clustering_stability, eval=TRUE}
adjusted_rand_index <- function(labels_a, labels_b) {
  ok <- !is.na(labels_a) & !is.na(labels_b)
  a <- as.factor(labels_a[ok])
  b <- as.factor(labels_b[ok])

  if (length(a) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  tab <- table(a, b)
  choose2 <- function(x) x * (x - 1) / 2

  sum_nij <- sum(choose2(tab))
  sum_ai <- sum(choose2(rowSums(tab)))
  sum_bj <- sum(choose2(colSums(tab)))
  n2 <- choose2(sum(tab))

  if (n2 == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  expected <- sum_ai * sum_bj / n2
  max_index <- 0.5 * (sum_ai + sum_bj)
  denom <- max_index - expected

  if (!is.finite(denom) || denom == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  (sum_nij - expected) / denom
}

sequence_pattern_frequency <- place_phase_sequence_wide |>
  dplyr::group_by(

  dplyr::summarise(
    n_places = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

active_sequence_patterns <- sequence_pattern_frequency
active_pattern_presence_sum <- rowSums(
  as.matrix(
    dplyr::select(
      active_sequence_patterns,
      dplyr::all_of(phase_cols)
    )
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
active_sequence_patterns <- active_sequence_patterns[
  active_pattern_presence_sum > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(active_sequence_patterns) >= 2) {
  pattern_matrix <- active_sequence_patterns |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(phase_cols)) |>
    as.matrix()

  rownames(pattern_matrix) <- active_sequence_patterns$sequence_string_7digit

  sequence_dist <- stats::dist(pattern_matrix, method = "binary")
  sequence_hclust <- stats::hclust(sequence_dist, method = "average")

  k_candidates_effective <- cluster_k_candidates[
    cluster_k_candidates >= 2 &
      cluster_k_candidates <= max(2, nrow(active_sequence_patterns) - 1L)
  ]

  evaluate_cluster_k <- function(k_value) {
    labels_full <- stats::cutree(sequence_hclust, k = k_value)
    sil <- cluster::silhouette(labels_full, sequence_dist)[, "sil_width"]

    set.seed(sequence_cluster_seed + k_value)
    stability_values <- rep(NA_real_, cluster_stability_repeats)

    for (b in seq_len(cluster_stability_repeats)) {
      sample_n <- max(
        k_value + 1L,
        floor(nrow(active_sequence_patterns) * cluster_stability_fraction)
      )
      sample_n <- min(sample_n, nrow(active_sequence_patterns))
      idx <- sort(sample(seq_len(nrow(active_sequence_patterns)), sample_n, replace = FALSE))

      sub_dist <- stats::as.dist(as.matrix(sequence_dist)[idx, idx, drop = FALSE])
      sub_hclust <- stats::hclust(sub_dist, method = "average")
      labels_sub <- stats::cutree(sub_hclust, k = k_value)

      stability_values[b] <- adjusted_rand_index(
        labels_full[idx],
        labels_sub
      )
    }

    cluster_sizes_pattern <- table(labels_full)
    cluster_sizes_places <- tapply(
      active_sequence_patterns$n_places,
      labels_full,
      sum
    )

    tibble::tibble(
      k = k_value,
      mean_silhouette_unweighted = mean(sil, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_silhouette_frequency_weighted = stats::weighted.mean(
        sil,
        w = active_sequence_patterns$n_places,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      stability_ari_mean = mean(stability_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      stability_ari_sd = stats::sd(stability_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_cluster_patterns = min(cluster_sizes_pattern),
      max_cluster_patterns = max(cluster_sizes_pattern),
      min_cluster_places = min(cluster_sizes_places),
      max_cluster_places = max(cluster_sizes_places),
      max_cluster_share_places = max(cluster_sizes_places) / sum(cluster_sizes_places)
    )
  }

  sequence_cluster_k_evaluation <- purrr::map_dfr(
    k_candidates_effective,
    evaluate_cluster_k
  )

  if (!is.na(cluster_k_manual)) {
    selected_cluster_k <- as.integer(cluster_k_manual)
    cluster_k_selection_method <- "manual_override"
  } else {
    selected_row <- sequence_cluster_k_evaluation |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::desc(mean_silhouette_frequency_weighted),
        dplyr::desc(stability_ari_mean),
        k
      ) |>
      dplyr::slice(1)

    selected_cluster_k <- selected_row$k[[1]]
    cluster_k_selection_method <- "max_frequency_weighted_silhouette_then_stability"
  }

  main_pattern_labels <- stats::cutree(
    sequence_hclust,
    k = selected_cluster_k
  )

  sequence_pattern_cluster <- active_sequence_patterns |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      sequence_string_7digit,
      n_places,
      sequence_cluster_id = paste0(
        "SC",
        unname(main_pattern_labels)
      )
    )

  # 最大クラスタを補助的に再クラスタリングする。
  dominant_cluster_id <- sequence_pattern_cluster |>
    dplyr::group_by(sequence_cluster_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_places = sum(n_places), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_places)) |>
    dplyr::slice(1) |>
    dplyr::pull(sequence_cluster_id)

  dominant_share <- sequence_pattern_cluster |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      share = sum(n_places[sequence_cluster_id == dominant_cluster_id]) / sum(n_places)
    ) |>
    dplyr::pull(share)

  dominant_patterns <- sequence_pattern_cluster |>
    dplyr::filter(sequence_cluster_id == dominant_cluster_id) |>
    dplyr::pull(sequence_string_7digit)

  sequence_dominant_subcluster_evaluation <- tibble::tibble()
  sequence_dominant_subcluster <- tibble::tibble(
    sequence_string_7digit = character(0),
    dominant_subcluster_id = character(0)
  )

  if (
    is.finite(dominant_share) &&
      dominant_share >= dominant_cluster_share_threshold &&
      length(dominant_patterns) >= 3
  ) {
    dom_idx <- match(
      dominant_patterns,
      active_sequence_patterns$sequence_string_7digit
    )
    dom_dist <- stats::as.dist(
      as.matrix(sequence_dist)[dom_idx, dom_idx, drop = FALSE]
    )
    dom_hclust <- stats::hclust(dom_dist, method = "average")
    dom_weights <- active_sequence_patterns$n_places[dom_idx]

    dom_k_values <- subcluster_k_candidates[
      subcluster_k_candidates >= 2 &
        subcluster_k_candidates <= max(2, length(dom_idx) - 1L)
    ]

    sequence_dominant_subcluster_evaluation <- purrr::map_dfr(
      dom_k_values,
      function(k_value) {
        lab <- stats::cutree(dom_hclust, k = k_value)
        sil <- cluster::silhouette(lab, dom_dist)[, "sil_width"]
        tibble::tibble(
          parent_cluster_id = dominant_cluster_id,
          parent_cluster_share = dominant_share,
          sub_k = k_value,
          mean_silhouette_unweighted = mean(sil, na.rm = TRUE),
          mean_silhouette_frequency_weighted = stats::weighted.mean(
            sil,
            w = dom_weights,
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        )
      }
    )

    selected_sub_k <- sequence_dominant_subcluster_evaluation |>
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_silhouette_frequency_weighted), sub_k) |>
      dplyr::slice(1) |>
      dplyr::pull(sub_k)

    dom_labels <- stats::cutree(dom_hclust, k = selected_sub_k)

    sequence_dominant_subcluster <- tibble::tibble(
      sequence_string_7digit = dominant_patterns,
      dominant_subcluster_id = paste0(
        dominant_cluster_id,
        "_sub",
        unname(dom_labels)
      )
    )
  }
} else {
  selected_cluster_k <- 1L
  cluster_k_selection_method <- "single_active_pattern"
  sequence_cluster_k_evaluation <- tibble::tibble()
  sequence_pattern_cluster <- active_sequence_patterns |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      sequence_string_7digit,
      n_places,
      sequence_cluster_id = "SC1"
    )
  dominant_cluster_id <- "SC1"
  dominant_share <- 1
  sequence_dominant_subcluster_evaluation <- tibble::tibble()
  sequence_dominant_subcluster <- tibble::tibble(
    sequence_string_7digit = character(0),
    dominant_subcluster_id = character(0)
  )
}

sequence_cluster_selection <- tibble::tibble(

cluster_phase_profile <- place_sequence_cluster |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    place_phase_long |>
      dplyr::select(place_id, phase_code, phase_order, presence),
    by = "place_id"
  ) |>
```

# 12. active-transition-summaries

**目的**：隣接時期の `continue / drop / new` 構成比を、`0→0` を除いたActive transitionとして明示的に算出する。

```{r c12_active_transition_summaries, eval=TRUE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# all_land_use legacy-compatible outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------
phase_presence_summary <- place_phase_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    phase_code,
    phase_order,
    phase_label_ja
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_places = dplyr::n_distinct(
      place_id
    ),
    presence_count = sum(
      presence,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    apparent_absence_count = sum(
      presence == 0L,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    presence_rate =
      presence_count /
      n_places,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    phase_order
  )

phase_transition_long <- place_phase_sequence_wide |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id,
    dplyr::all_of(
      phase_cols
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(
      phase_cols
    ),
    names_to = "phase_code",
    values_to = "presence"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    chronology_phase_table |>
      dplyr::select(
        phase_code,
        phase_order
      ),
    by = "phase_code"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    place_id,
    phase_order
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    place_id
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    next_phase_code = dplyr::lead(
      phase_code
    ),
    next_phase_order = dplyr::lead(
      phase_order
    ),
    next_presence = dplyr::lead(
      presence
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(
      next_phase_code
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    transition = dplyr::case_when(
      presence == 1L &
        next_presence == 1L ~
        "continue",
      presence == 1L &
        next_presence == 0L ~
        "drop",
      presence == 0L &
        next_presence == 1L ~
        "new",
      TRUE ~
        "apparent_absence_continue"
    ),
    phase_pair = paste0(
      phase_code,
      "->",
      next_phase_code
    ),
    phase_pair_order = phase_order
  )

phase_transition_pair_table <- phase_transition_long |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    phase_pair,
    phase_pair_order
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    phase_pair_order
  )

active_transition_counts <- phase_transition_long |>
  dplyr::filter(
    transition !=
      "apparent_absence_continue"
  ) |>
  dplyr::count(
    phase_pair,
    phase_pair_order,
    transition,
    name = "n_places"
  )

all_transition_totals <- phase_transition_long |>
  dplyr::count(
    phase_pair,
    phase_pair_order,
    transition,
    name = "n_places_all_state"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    phase_pair,
    phase_pair_order
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_places_all_states = sum(
      n_places_all_state
    ),
    apparent_absence_continue_excluded = sum(
      n_places_all_state[
        transition ==
          "apparent_absence_continue"
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

active_transition_summary <- tidyr::crossing(
  phase_transition_pair_table,
  transition = transition_levels
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    active_transition_counts,
    by = c(
      "phase_pair",
      "phase_pair_order",
      "transition"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_places = tidyr::replace_na(
      n_places,
      0L
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    phase_pair,
    phase_pair_order
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    active_total_places = sum(
      n_places
    ),
    active_transition_composition = dplyr::if_else(
      active_total_places > 0,
      n_places /
        active_total_places,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    all_transition_totals,
    by = c(
      "phase_pair",
      "phase_pair_order"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    phase_pair_order,
    factor(
      transition,
      levels = transition_levels
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# activity-domain phase presence
#
# presence_rate denominator = resolved states only.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
activity_domain_phase_presence_summary <- place_phase_activity_long |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    activity_domain_place_membership |>

    ),

      !is.na(presence)
    ),
    n_unresolved_places = sum(
      is.na(presence)
    ),
    phase_resolution_rate = dplyr::if_else(
      n_domain_member_places > 0,
      n_resolved_places /
        n_domain_member_places,

    ),
    presence_count = sum(
      presence == 1L,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    apparent_absence_count = sum(
      presence == 0L,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    presence_rate = dplyr::if_else(
      n_resolved_places > 0,
      presence_count /
        n_resolved_places,
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    activity_domain,
    phase_order
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# activity-domain transition
#
# if either side is NA -> temporally_unresolved_transition
# and it is excluded from transition denominators.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
activity_domain_transition_long <- place_phase_activity_long |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    activity_domain_place_membership |>
      dplyr::select(
        activity_domain,

    activity_domain,

  ) |>

  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(

  dplyr::mutate(
    transition_resolution = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(presence) |

    ),
    transition = dplyr::case_when(
      transition_resolution ==
        "temporally_unresolved" ~

      presence == 1L &
        next_presence == 1L ~
        "continue",
      presence == 1L &
        next_presence == 0L ~
        "drop",
      presence == 0L &
        next_presence == 1L ~
        "new",
      TRUE ~
        "apparent_absence_continue"
    ),
    phase_pair = paste0(
      phase_code,
      "->",
      next_phase_code
    ),
    phase_pair_order = phase_order

activity_domain_transition_resolution_summary <-
```

```{r c13_markov_transition_model, eval=TRUE}
      presence == 1L,
      "presence",
      "apparent_absence"

    to_state = dplyr::if_else(
      next_presence == 1L,
      "presence",
      "apparent_absence"
    )
  ) |>
```

# 14. change-point-screening

**目的**：7点系列では推測統計的な多重変化点検出を行わず、presence率とActive transition構成比の単一break候補を探索する。

```{r c14_change_point_screening, eval=TRUE}
screen_single_break <- function(
  values,
  labels,
  metric_name,
  min_segment = 2L,
  scope_type = "overall",
  scope_id = "all",
  scope_label = "all",
  activity_domain = "all_land_use"
) {
  values <- as.numeric(
    values
  )

  labels <- as.character(
    labels
  )

  valid <- is.finite(
    values
  ) &
    !is.na(
      labels
    )

  values <- values[
    valid
  ]

  labels <- labels[
    valid
  ]

  n <- length(
    values
  )

  empty <- tibble::tibble(
    scope_type = character(0),
    scope_id = character(0),
    scope_label = character(0),
    activity_domain = character(0),
    metric = character(0),
    candidate_order = integer(0),
    left_label = character(0),
    right_label = character(0),
    change_label = character(0),
    left_mean = double(0),
    right_mean = double(0),
    delta_mean = double(0),
    sse_no_break = double(0),
    sse_with_break = double(0),
    change_score = double(0),
    best_candidate = logical(0)
  )

  if (
    n <
      2L *
        min_segment
  ) {
    return(
      empty
    )
  }

  sse_no_break <- sum(
    (
      values -
        mean(values)
    )^2
  )

  split_positions <- seq.int(
    min_segment,
    n - min_segment
  )

  out <- purrr::map_dfr(
    split_positions,
    function(split_pos) {
      left_values <- values[
        seq_len(
          split_pos
        )
      ]

      right_values <- values[
        (split_pos + 1L):n
      ]

      sse_with_break <- sum(
        (
          left_values -
            mean(left_values)
        )^2
      ) +
        sum(
          (
            right_values -
              mean(right_values)
          )^2
        )

      change_score <- if (
        is.finite(
          sse_no_break
        ) &&
          sse_no_break > 0
      ) {
        (
          sse_no_break -
            sse_with_break
        ) /
          sse_no_break
      } else {
        0
      }

      tibble::tibble(
        scope_type,
        scope_id,
        scope_label,
        activity_domain,
        metric = metric_name,
        candidate_order = split_pos,
        left_label = labels[
          split_pos
        ],
        right_label = labels[
          split_pos + 1L
        ],
        change_label = paste0(
          labels[
            split_pos
          ],
          " | ",
          labels[
            split_pos + 1L
          ]
        ),
        left_mean = mean(
          left_values
        ),
        right_mean = mean(
          right_values
        ),
        delta_mean =
          mean(
            right_values
          ) -
          mean(
            left_values
          ),
        sse_no_break,
        sse_with_break,
        change_score
      )
    }
  )

  best_index <- which.max(
    out$change_score
  )

  out$best_candidate <-
    seq_len(
      nrow(out)
    ) ==
    best_index

  out
}

# activity-domain別に同じ4 metricを評価する。
activity_change_point_candidates <- purrr::map_dfr(
  unique(
    activity_domain_phase_presence_summary$activity_domain

      dplyr::filter(

      pp$presence_rate,

      "presence_rate",
      change_point_min_segment,
      activity_domain = domain_name
    )

    transition_cp <- purrr::map_dfr(
      transition_levels,

          dplyr::filter(
            activity_domain == domain_name,
            transition == target_transition
          ) |>

          tt$phase_pair,
          paste0(
            target_transition,
            "_active_transition_composition"
          ),
          change_point_min_segment,
          activity_domain = domain_name
        )
      }
    )

    dplyr::bind_rows(
      presence_cp,
      transition_cp
    )
  }
)
```

# 17. spatial-neighbor-and-global-sensitivity

**目的**：k=4/8/12を毎回比較し、edge距離とGlobal Moran's Iの頑健性を診断する。Transition空間分析では各時期ペアの0→0を除外し、active地点だけで近隣関係を再構築する。fixed-distance比較はモデル較正時のみ実行可能とする。

```{r c17_spatial_neighbor_and_global_sensitivity, eval=TRUE}
build_symmetric_knn_nb <- function(coords, k) {
  k_eff <- min(as.integer(k), nrow(coords) - 1L)

  if (k_eff < 1) {
    stop("kNNを作成できる地点数がありません。")
  }

  # identical pointsを保持したままlegacy 2D検索を使用する。
  # 保存座標や解析geometryをjitterしない。
  knn <- suppressWarnings(
    spdep::knearneigh(
      coords,
      k = k_eff,
      longlat = FALSE,
      use_kd_tree = FALSE
    )
  )

  spdep::knn2nb(knn, sym = TRUE)
}

nb_to_edges <- function(nb, coords, place_ids, model_id, k_value = NA_integer_) {
  purrr::map_dfr(
    seq_along(nb),
    function(i) {
      nbi <- nb[[i]]

      if (length(nbi) == 0) {
        return(tibble::tibble())
      }

      tibble::tibble(
        from_index = i,
        to_index = nbi
      )
    }
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(from_index < to_index) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model_id = model_id,
      k = k_value,
      from_place_id = place_ids[from_index],
      to_place_id = place_ids[to_index],
      edge_distance_m = sqrt(
        (coords[from_index, 1] - coords[to_index, 1])^2 +
          (coords[from_index, 2] - coords[to_index, 2])^2
      )
    )
}

global_moran_one <- function(x, metric_name, listw_object, model_id) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)

  if (
    length(x) < 3 ||
      sum(is.finite(x)) < 3 ||
      length(unique(x[is.finite(x)])) < 2
  ) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      model_id = model_id,
      metric = metric_name,
      n_points = sum(is.finite(x)),
      moran_i = NA_real_,
      expectation = NA_real_,
      variance = NA_real_,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  result <- tryCatch(
    spdep::moran.test(
      x,
      listw_object,
      zero.policy = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(result)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      model_id = model_id,
      metric = metric_name,
      n_points = length(x),
      moran_i = NA_real_,
      expectation = NA_real_,
      variance = NA_real_,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    model_id = model_id,
    metric = metric_name,
    n_points = length(x),
    moran_i = unname(result$estimate[[1]]),
    expectation = unname(result$estimate[[2]]),
    variance = unname(result$estimate[[3]]),
    statistic = unname(result$statistic[[1]]),
    p_value = result$p.value
  )
}

available_spatial_metrics <- intersect(
  spatial_continuous_metrics,
  names(spatial_base_metric_sf)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. continuity / gap metrics:
#    全空間分析対象地点を使う従来のkNNモデル
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
knn_models <- list()
spatial_neighbor_edges_all <- list()
spatial_neighbor_diagnostics_list <- list()
spatial_global_moran_list <- list()

for (k_value in spatial_k_values) {
  k_eff <- min(k_value, nrow(spatial_base_metric_sf) - 1L)
  model_id <- paste0("knn_k", k_eff)

  nb <- build_symmetric_knn_nb(coords_metric, k_eff)
  listw_w <- spdep::nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
  listw_b <- spdep::nb2listw(nb, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)

  knn_models[[as.character(k_value)]] <- list(
    model_id = model_id,
    k = k_eff,
    nb = nb,
    listw_w = listw_w,
    listw_b = listw_b
  )

  edges <- nb_to_edges(
    nb,
    coords_metric,
    spatial_base_metric_sf$place_id,
    model_id,
    k_eff
  )

  spatial_neighbor_edges_all[[as.character(k_value)]] <- edges

  degree <- lengths(nb)

  diag_row <- tibble::tibble(
    model_id = model_id,
    k = k_eff,
    n_points = nrow(spatial_base_metric_sf),
    n_edges = nrow(edges),
    n_isolates = sum(degree == 0),
    mean_degree = mean(degree),
    median_degree = stats::median(degree),
    max_degree = max(degree),
    edge_min_m = ifelse(
      nrow(edges) > 0,
      min(edges$edge_distance_m),
      NA_real_
    ),
    edge_median_m = ifelse(
      nrow(edges) > 0,
      stats::median(edges$edge_distance_m),
      NA_real_
    ),
    edge_p90_m = ifelse(
      nrow(edges) > 0,
      as.numeric(stats::quantile(edges$edge_distance_m, 0.90)),
      NA_real_
    ),
    edge_p95_m = ifelse(
      nrow(edges) > 0,
      as.numeric(stats::quantile(edges$edge_distance_m, 0.95)),
      NA_real_
    ),
    edge_p99_m = ifelse(
      nrow(edges) > 0,
      as.numeric(stats::quantile(edges$edge_distance_m, 0.99)),
      NA_real_
    ),
    edge_max_m = ifelse(
      nrow(edges) > 0,
      max(edges$edge_distance_m),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

  for (threshold_m in edge_diagnostic_thresholds_m) {
    diag_row[[paste0("n_edges_gt_", threshold_m, "m")]] <- ifelse(
      nrow(edges) > 0,
      sum(edges$edge_distance_m > threshold_m),
      0L
    )

    diag_row[[paste0("prop_edges_gt_", threshold_m, "m")]] <- ifelse(
      nrow(edges) > 0,
      mean(edges$edge_distance_m > threshold_m),
      NA_real_
    )
  }

  spatial_neighbor_diagnostics_list[[as.character(k_value)]] <- diag_row

  spatial_global_moran_list[[as.character(k_value)]] <- purrr::map_dfr(
    available_spatial_metrics,
    function(metric_name) {
      global_moran_one(
        spatial_base_metric_sf[[metric_name]],
        metric_name,
        listw_w,
        model_id
      ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(k = k_eff)
    }
  )
}

spatial_neighbor_edges <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  spatial_neighbor_edges_all
)

spatial_neighbor_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  spatial_neighbor_diagnostics_list
)

spatial_global_moran <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  spatial_global_moran_list
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. Transition spatial universe
#
# IMPORTANT:
# 各時期ペアで 0->0 (apparent_absence_continue) を除外する。
# その後、その時期ペアでactiveな地点だけからkNNを再構築する。
#
# これにより、Pa/Joともに見かけ上不在の後代地点などが
# 「Pa->Jo newの少ない地域」として空間分析へ混入することを防ぐ。
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
transition_pair_spatial_list <- list()
transition_universe_rows <- list()

for (pair_value in phase_transition_pair_table$phase_pair) {
  pair_data <- phase_transition_long |>
    dplyr::filter(phase_pair == pair_value) |>
    dplyr::select(
      place_id,
      phase_pair,
      phase_pair_order,
      presence,
      next_presence,
      transition
    )

  pair_all_spatial <- spatial_base_metric_sf |>
    dplyr::select(place_id) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      pair_data,
      by = "place_id"
    )

  pair_active_spatial <- pair_all_spatial |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(transition),
      transition != "apparent_absence_continue"
    )

  if (nrow(pair_active_spatial) < 3) {
    stop(
      "Transition空間分析に必要なactive地点数が不足しています: ",
      pair_value,
      " n=",
      nrow(pair_active_spatial)
    )
  }

  transition_pair_spatial_list[[pair_value]] <- pair_active_spatial

  transition_universe_rows[[pair_value]] <- tibble::tibble(
    phase_pair = pair_value,
    phase_pair_order = {
      ord <- unique(stats::na.omit(pair_active_spatial$phase_pair_order))
      if (length(ord) > 0) ord[[1]] else NA_integer_
    },
    n_spatial_points_all_states = nrow(pair_all_spatial),
    n_active_transition_points = nrow(pair_active_spatial),
    n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded = sum(
      pair_all_spatial$transition == "apparent_absence_continue",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    active_transition_share = nrow(pair_active_spatial) / nrow(pair_all_spatial),
    n_continue = sum(pair_active_spatial$transition == "continue"),
    n_drop = sum(pair_active_spatial$transition == "drop"),
    n_new = sum(pair_active_spatial$transition == "new"),
    analysis_universe = "active_transition_only_excluding_0to0"
  )
}

transition_spatial_universe_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  transition_universe_rows
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(phase_pair_order)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# C. Transition kNN:
#    k=4/8/12ごと、かつ時期ペアごとにactive地点だけで再構築
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
transition_knn_models <- list()
spatial_transition_neighbor_edges_list <- list()
spatial_transition_neighbor_diagnostics_list <- list()
spatial_transition_global_list <- list()

for (k_value in spatial_k_values) {
  k_key <- as.character(k_value)
  transition_knn_models[[k_key]] <- list()

  transition_global_rows <- list()
  global_idx <- 1L

  for (pair_value in phase_transition_pair_table$phase_pair) {
    pair_spatial <- transition_pair_spatial_list[[pair_value]]
    pair_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(pair_spatial)

    k_eff <- min(
      as.integer(k_value),
      nrow(pair_spatial) - 1L
    )

    model_id <- paste0(
      "transition_",
      safe_name(pair_value),
      "_knn_k",
      k_eff
    )

    nb_pair <- build_symmetric_knn_nb(
      pair_coords,
      k_eff
    )

    listw_w_pair <- spdep::nb2listw(
      nb_pair,
      style = "W",
      zero.policy = TRUE
    )

    listw_b_pair <- spdep::nb2listw(
      nb_pair,
      style = "B",
      zero.policy = TRUE
    )

    transition_knn_models[[k_key]][[pair_value]] <- list(
      model_id = model_id,
      k = k_eff,
      phase_pair = pair_value,
      place_ids = pair_spatial$place_id,
      nb = nb_pair,
      listw_w = listw_w_pair,
      listw_b = listw_b_pair
    )

    pair_edges <- nb_to_edges(
      nb_pair,
      pair_coords,
      pair_spatial$place_id,
      model_id,
      k_eff
    ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        phase_pair = pair_value,
        phase_pair_order = {
          ord <- unique(stats::na.omit(pair_spatial$phase_pair_order))
          if (length(ord) > 0) ord[[1]] else NA_integer_
        },
        analysis_universe = "active_transition_only_excluding_0to0"
      )

    spatial_transition_neighbor_edges_list[[
      paste(k_key, pair_value, sep = "__")
    ]] <- pair_edges

    degree <- lengths(nb_pair)

    pair_diag <- tibble::tibble(
      model_id = model_id,
      k = k_eff,
      phase_pair = pair_value,
      phase_pair_order = {
        ord <- unique(stats::na.omit(pair_spatial$phase_pair_order))
        if (length(ord) > 0) ord[[1]] else NA_integer_
      },
      n_points = nrow(pair_spatial),
      n_edges = nrow(pair_edges),
      n_isolates = sum(degree == 0),
      mean_degree = mean(degree),
      median_degree = stats::median(degree),
      max_degree = max(degree),
      edge_min_m = ifelse(
        nrow(pair_edges) > 0,
        min(pair_edges$edge_distance_m),
        NA_real_
      ),
      edge_median_m = ifelse(
        nrow(pair_edges) > 0,
        stats::median(pair_edges$edge_distance_m),
        NA_real_
      ),
      edge_p90_m = ifelse(
        nrow(pair_edges) > 0,
        as.numeric(stats::quantile(pair_edges$edge_distance_m, 0.90)),
        NA_real_
      ),
      edge_p95_m = ifelse(
        nrow(pair_edges) > 0,
        as.numeric(stats::quantile(pair_edges$edge_distance_m, 0.95)),
        NA_real_
      ),
      edge_p99_m = ifelse(
        nrow(pair_edges) > 0,
        as.numeric(stats::quantile(pair_edges$edge_distance_m, 0.99)),
        NA_real_
      ),
      edge_max_m = ifelse(
        nrow(pair_edges) > 0,
        max(pair_edges$edge_distance_m),
        NA_real_
      ),
      analysis_universe = "active_transition_only_excluding_0to0"
    )

    for (threshold_m in edge_diagnostic_thresholds_m) {
      pair_diag[[paste0("n_edges_gt_", threshold_m, "m")]] <- ifelse(
        nrow(pair_edges) > 0,
        sum(pair_edges$edge_distance_m > threshold_m),
        0L
      )

      pair_diag[[paste0("prop_edges_gt_", threshold_m, "m")]] <- ifelse(
        nrow(pair_edges) > 0,
        mean(pair_edges$edge_distance_m > threshold_m),
        NA_real_
      )
    }

    spatial_transition_neighbor_diagnostics_list[[
      paste(k_key, pair_value, sep = "__")
    ]] <- pair_diag

    universe_row <- transition_spatial_universe_summary |>
      dplyr::filter(phase_pair == pair_value)

    for (event_name in spatial_transition_global_events) {
      event_value <- as.integer(
        pair_spatial$transition == event_name
      )

      transition_global_rows[[global_idx]] <- global_moran_one(
        event_value,
        paste0(pair_value, "__", event_name),
        listw_w_pair,
        model_id
      ) |>
        dplyr::transmute(
          model_id,
          k = k_eff,
          phase_pair = pair_value,
          phase_pair_order = universe_row$phase_pair_order[[1]],
          event_type = event_name,
          event_count = sum(event_value),
          event_prevalence = mean(event_value),
          n_points,
          n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded =
            universe_row$n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded[[1]],
          analysis_universe =
            "active_transition_only_excluding_0to0",
          moran_i,
          expectation,
          variance,
          statistic,
          p_value
        )

      global_idx <- global_idx + 1L
    }
  }

  spatial_transition_global_list[[k_key]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    transition_global_rows
  )
}

spatial_transition_neighbor_edges <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  spatial_transition_neighbor_edges_list
)

spatial_transition_neighbor_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  spatial_transition_neighbor_diagnostics_list
)

spatial_transition_global_moran <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  spatial_transition_global_list
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# D. continuity index weight感度 × kNN感度
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
continuity_weight_spatial_robustness <- purrr::map_dfr(
  spatial_k_values,
  function(k_value) {
    model <- knn_models[[as.character(k_value)]]

    weight_wide <- continuity_weight_scores |>
      dplyr::select(
        place_id,
        weight_set,
        continuity_index
      ) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = weight_set,
        values_from = continuity_index
      )

    ordered <- spatial_base_metric_sf |>
      sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
      dplyr::select(place_id) |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        weight_wide,
        by = "place_id"
      )

    purrr::map_dfr(
      continuity_weight_sets$weight_set,
      function(weight_set_value) {
        global_moran_one(
          ordered[[weight_set_value]],
          paste0("continuity_", weight_set_value),
          model$listw_w,
          model$model_id
        ) |>
          dplyr::mutate(
            k = model$k,
            weight_set = weight_set_value
          )
      }
    )
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# E. fixed-distance calibration
#
# continuity/gap:
#   全地点モデル
#
# transition:
#   時期ペアごとのactive地点だけで距離近傍を再構築
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fixed_distance_neighbor_diagnostics <- tibble::tibble()
fixed_distance_global_moran <- tibble::tibble()
fixed_distance_transition_global_moran <- tibble::tibble()

if (isTRUE(run_fixed_distance_calibration)) {
  fixed_diag_list <- list()
  fixed_global_list <- list()
  fixed_transition_list <- list()

  for (band_m in fixed_distance_bands_m) {
    model_id <- paste0("fixed_", band_m, "m")

    nb_band <- spdep::dnearneigh(
      coords_metric,
      d1 = 0,
      d2 = band_m,
      longlat = FALSE
    )

    listw_band <- spdep::nb2listw(
      nb_band,
      style = "W",
      zero.policy = TRUE
    )

    degree <- lengths(nb_band)

    fixed_diag_list[[as.character(band_m)]] <- tibble::tibble(
      model_id = model_id,
      distance_band_m = band_m,
      n_points = nrow(spatial_base_metric_sf),
      n_isolates = sum(degree == 0),
      mean_degree = mean(degree),
      median_degree = stats::median(degree),
      max_degree = max(degree),
      connected_share = mean(degree > 0)
    )

    fixed_global_list[[as.character(band_m)]] <- purrr::map_dfr(
      available_spatial_metrics,
      function(metric_name) {
        global_moran_one(
          spatial_base_metric_sf[[metric_name]],
          metric_name,
          listw_band,
          model_id
        ) |>
          dplyr::mutate(
            distance_band_m = band_m
          )
      }
    )

    transition_rows <- list()
    transition_idx <- 1L

    for (pair_value in phase_transition_pair_table$phase_pair) {
      pair_spatial <- transition_pair_spatial_list[[pair_value]]
      pair_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(pair_spatial)

      pair_model_id <- paste0(
        "transition_",
        safe_name(pair_value),
        "_fixed_",
        band_m,
        "m"
      )

      nb_band_pair <- spdep::dnearneigh(
        pair_coords,
        d1 = 0,
        d2 = band_m,
        longlat = FALSE
      )

      listw_band_pair <- spdep::nb2listw(
        nb_band_pair,
        style = "W",
        zero.policy = TRUE
      )

      universe_row <- transition_spatial_universe_summary |>
        dplyr::filter(
          phase_pair == pair_value
        )

      for (event_name in spatial_transition_global_events) {
        event_value <- as.integer(
          pair_spatial$transition == event_name
        )

        transition_rows[[transition_idx]] <- global_moran_one(
          event_value,
          paste0(pair_value, "__", event_name),
          listw_band_pair,
          pair_model_id
        ) |>
          dplyr::mutate(
            distance_band_m = band_m,
            phase_pair = pair_value,
            phase_pair_order = universe_row$phase_pair_order[[1]],
            event_type = event_name,
            event_count = sum(event_value),
            event_prevalence = mean(event_value),
            n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded =
              universe_row$n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded[[1]],
            analysis_universe =
              "active_transition_only_excluding_0to0"
          )

        transition_idx <- transition_idx + 1L
      }
    }

    fixed_transition_list[[as.character(band_m)]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      transition_rows
    )
  }

  fixed_distance_neighbor_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    fixed_diag_list
  )

  fixed_distance_global_moran <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    fixed_global_list
  )

  fixed_distance_transition_global_moran <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    fixed_transition_list
  )
}
```
