# 18. local-spatial-statistics

**目的**：Local Moranはraw/BHを併記してBH後を結論基準とする。Transitionのbinary eventは各時期ペアの0→0除外後のactive地点だけを対象とし、rare eventにLocal Join Count、common eventにLocal G*＋補集合Join Countを適用する。

```{r c18_local_spatial_statistics, eval=TRUE}
extract_sim_p <- function(df, fallback_z = NULL) {
  sim_cols <- grep(
    "Sim",
    names(df),
    value = TRUE,
    fixed = TRUE
  )

  sim_cols <- sim_cols[
    !grepl(
      "folded",
      sim_cols,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]

  if (length(sim_cols) > 0) {
    return(
      as.numeric(
        df[[sim_cols[1]]]
      )
    )
  }

  p_cols <- grep(
    "^Pr",
    names(df),
    value = TRUE
  )

  if (length(p_cols) > 0) {
    return(
      as.numeric(
        df[[p_cols[1]]]
      )
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(fallback_z)) {
    return(
      2 * stats::pnorm(
        abs(fallback_z),
        lower.tail = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  rep(
    NA_real_,
    nrow(df)
  )
}

local_moran_one <- function(
  place_ids,
  x,
  metric_name,
  listw_object,
  model_id,
  k_value
) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)

  if (
    length(x) < 3 ||
      length(unique(x[is.finite(x)])) < 2
  ) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      place_id = place_ids,
      model_id,
      k = k_value,
      metric = metric_name,
      value = x,
      z_value = NA_real_,
      spatial_lag_z = NA_real_,
      local_moran_i = NA_real_,
      local_moran_z = NA_real_,
      p_raw = NA_real_,
      p_bh = NA_real_,
      lisa_class_raw = "not_tested",
      lisa_class_bh = "not_tested"
    ))
  }

  x_mean <- mean(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  x_sd <- stats::sd(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  z_value <- if (
    !is.finite(x_sd) ||
      x_sd == 0
  ) {
    rep(
      0,
      length(x)
    )
  } else {
    (x - x_mean) / x_sd
  }

  spatial_lag_z <- spdep::lag.listw(
    listw_object,
    z_value,
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )

  res <- tryCatch(
    spdep::localmoran_perm(
      x,
      listw_object,
      nsim = spatial_permutations,
      zero.policy = TRUE,
      alternative = "two.sided",
      iseed = spatial_seed
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(res)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      place_id = place_ids,
      model_id,
      k = k_value,
      metric = metric_name,
      value = x,
      z_value = z_value,
      spatial_lag_z = as.numeric(spatial_lag_z),
      local_moran_i = NA_real_,
      local_moran_z = NA_real_,
      p_raw = NA_real_,
      p_bh = NA_real_,
      lisa_class_raw = "not_tested",
      lisa_class_bh = "not_tested"
    ))
  }

  rdf <- as.data.frame(res)

  local_i <- if (
    "Ii" %in% names(rdf)
  ) {
    rdf[["Ii"]]
  } else {
    rdf[[1]]
  }

  local_z <- if (
    "Z.Ii" %in% names(rdf)
  ) {
    rdf[["Z.Ii"]]
  } else {
    rep(
      NA_real_,
      nrow(rdf)
    )
  }

  p_raw <- extract_sim_p(
    rdf,
    local_z
  )

  p_bh <- stats::p.adjust(
    p_raw,
    method = "BH"
  )

  classify_lisa <- function(p_value) {
    dplyr::case_when(
      p_value <= spatial_alpha &
        z_value > 0 &
        spatial_lag_z > 0 ~
        "High-High",

      p_value <= spatial_alpha &
        z_value < 0 &
        spatial_lag_z < 0 ~
        "Low-Low",

      p_value <= spatial_alpha &
        z_value > 0 &
        spatial_lag_z < 0 ~
        "High-Low",

      p_value <= spatial_alpha &
        z_value < 0 &
        spatial_lag_z > 0 ~
        "Low-High",

      TRUE ~
        "not_significant"
    )
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    place_id = place_ids,
    model_id,
    k = k_value,
    metric = metric_name,
    value = x,
    z_value = z_value,
    spatial_lag_z = as.numeric(spatial_lag_z),
    local_moran_i = as.numeric(local_i),
    local_moran_z = as.numeric(local_z),
    p_raw = p_raw,
    p_bh = p_bh,
    lisa_class_raw = classify_lisa(p_raw),
    lisa_class_bh = classify_lisa(p_bh)
  )
}

local_joincount_binary <- function(
  place_ids,
  event_value,
  phase_pair_value,
  event_name,
  model,
  target_label = "event",
  method_label = "local_join_count"
) {
  event_value <- as.integer(event_value)
  event_value[is.na(event_value)] <- 0L

  prevalence <- mean(event_value)

  base <- tibble::tibble(
    place_id = place_ids,
    model_id = model$model_id,
    k = model$k,
    phase_pair = phase_pair_value,
    event_type = event_name,
    target = target_label,
    method = method_label,
    event_value = event_value,
    event_prevalence = prevalence,
    local_stat = NA_real_,
    local_z = NA_real_,
    p_raw = NA_real_,
    p_bh = NA_real_,
    local_class_raw = dplyr::if_else(
      event_value == 1L,
      "event_not_tested",
      "non_event"
    ),
    local_class_bh = dplyr::if_else(
      event_value == 1L,
      "event_not_tested",
      "non_event"
    ),
    test_status = "not_tested"
  )

  if (
    sum(event_value) == 0L ||
      sum(event_value) == length(event_value)
  ) {
    base$test_status <- "not_tested_no_contrast"
    return(base)
  }

  event_factor <- factor(
    ifelse(
      event_value == 1L,
      "event",
      "other"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "other",
      "event"
    )
  )

  jr <- tryCatch(
    spdep::local_joincount_uni(
      event_factor,
      chosen = "event",
      listw = model$listw_b,
      alternative = "greater",
      nsim = spatial_permutations,
      iseed = spatial_seed
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(jr)) {
    base$test_status <- "not_tested_joincount_error"
    return(base)
  }

  jdf <- as.data.frame(jr)

  stat_value <- if (
    "BB" %in% names(jdf)
  ) {
    as.numeric(
      jdf[["BB"]]
    )
  } else {
    rep(
      NA_real_,
      nrow(jdf)
    )
  }

  p_raw <- if (
    "Pr()" %in% names(jdf)
  ) {
    as.numeric(
      jdf[["Pr()"]]
    )
  } else {
    rep(
      NA_real_,
      nrow(jdf)
    )
  }

  p_bh <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(p_raw)
  )

  tested_rows <- event_value == 1L &
    is.finite(p_raw)

  if (any(tested_rows)) {
    p_bh[tested_rows] <- stats::p.adjust(
      p_raw[tested_rows],
      method = "BH"
    )
  }

  base$local_stat <- stat_value
  base$p_raw <- p_raw
  base$p_bh <- p_bh

  base$local_class_raw <- dplyr::case_when(
    event_value == 0L ~
      "non_event",

    p_raw <= spatial_alpha &
      stat_value > 0 ~
      "event_cluster",

    TRUE ~
      "event_not_significant"
  )

  base$local_class_bh <- dplyr::case_when(
    event_value == 0L ~
      "non_event",

    p_bh <= spatial_alpha &
      stat_value > 0 ~
      "event_cluster",

    TRUE ~
      "event_not_significant"
  )

  base$test_status <- "tested_local_join_count"

  base
}

local_gstar_binary <- function(
  place_ids,
  event_value,
  phase_pair_value,
  event_name,
  model
) {
  event_value <- as.numeric(event_value)
  event_value[is.na(event_value)] <- 0

  nb_star <- spdep::include.self(
    model$nb
  )

  listw_star <- spdep::nb2listw(
    nb_star,
    style = "B",
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )

  gr <- tryCatch(
    spdep::localG_perm(
      event_value,
      listw_star,
      nsim = spatial_permutations,
      zero.policy = TRUE,
      alternative = "two.sided",
      iseed = spatial_seed
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(gr)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      place_id = place_ids,
      model_id = model$model_id,
      k = model$k,
      phase_pair = phase_pair_value,
      event_type = event_name,
      target = "event",
      method = "local_getis_ord_gstar",
      event_value = as.integer(event_value),
      event_prevalence = mean(event_value),
      local_stat = NA_real_,
      local_z = NA_real_,
      p_raw = NA_real_,
      p_bh = NA_real_,
      local_class_raw = "not_tested",
      local_class_bh = "not_tested",
      test_status = "not_tested_local_gstar_error"
    ))
  }

  z_value <- as.numeric(gr)
  internals <- attr(
    gr,
    "internals"
  )

  p_raw <- if (!is.null(internals)) {
    extract_sim_p(
      as.data.frame(internals),
      z_value
    )
  } else {
    2 * stats::pnorm(
      abs(z_value),
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )
  }

  p_bh <- stats::p.adjust(
    p_raw,
    method = "BH"
  )

  classify_g <- function(p_value) {
    dplyr::case_when(
      p_value <= spatial_alpha &
        z_value > 0 ~
        "event_hotspot",

      p_value <= spatial_alpha &
        z_value < 0 ~
        "event_coldspot",

      TRUE ~
        "not_significant"
    )
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    place_id = place_ids,
    model_id = model$model_id,
    k = model$k,
    phase_pair = phase_pair_value,
    event_type = event_name,
    target = "event",
    method = "local_getis_ord_gstar",
    event_value = as.integer(event_value),
    event_prevalence = mean(event_value),
    local_stat = z_value,
    local_z = z_value,
    p_raw = p_raw,
    p_bh = p_bh,
    local_class_raw = classify_g(p_raw),
    local_class_bh = classify_g(p_bh),
    test_status = "tested_local_getis_ord_gstar"
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. continuity / gap Local Moran:
#    従来どおり全空間分析対象地点を使用
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
spatial_local_lisa <- purrr::map_dfr(
  spatial_k_values,
  function(k_value) {
    model <- knn_models[[as.character(k_value)]]

    purrr::map_dfr(
      available_spatial_metrics,
      function(metric_name) {
        local_moran_one(
          spatial_base_metric_sf$place_id,
          spatial_base_metric_sf[[metric_name]],
          metric_name,
          model$listw_w,
          model$model_id,
          model$k
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. binary transition local statistics
#
# 各時期ペアの0->0を除外したactive地点だけを使う。
# kNNもそのactive地点だけで作り直したモデルを使用する。
# common / rare判定のprevalenceもactive地点を分母とする。
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
transition_local_list <- list()
transition_local_idx <- 1L

for (k_value in spatial_k_values) {
  k_key <- as.character(k_value)

  for (pair_value in phase_transition_pair_table$phase_pair) {
    pair_spatial <- transition_pair_spatial_list[[pair_value]]
    model <- transition_knn_models[[k_key]][[pair_value]]

    if (
      !identical(
        as.character(pair_spatial$place_id),
        as.character(model$place_ids)
      )
    ) {
      stop(
        "Transition local analysisの地点順がkNNモデルと一致しません: ",
        pair_value,
        " k=",
        k_value
      )
    }

    universe_row <- transition_spatial_universe_summary |>
      dplyr::filter(
        phase_pair == pair_value
      )

    for (event_name in spatial_transition_binary_events) {
      event_value <- as.integer(
        pair_spatial$transition == event_name
      )

      prevalence <- mean(
        event_value
      )

      if (prevalence <= 0.5) {
        one_result <- local_joincount_binary(
          pair_spatial$place_id,
          event_value,
          pair_value,
          event_name,
          model,
          target_label = "event",
          method_label = "local_join_count"
        ) |>
          dplyr::mutate(
            n_active_transition_points = nrow(pair_spatial),
            n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded =
              universe_row$n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded[[1]],
            analysis_universe =
              "active_transition_only_excluding_0to0"
          )

        transition_local_list[[transition_local_idx]] <- one_result
        transition_local_idx <- transition_local_idx + 1L

      } else {
        # common event:
        # eventそのものはLocal G*で、active地点内での高低を確認する。
        g_result <- local_gstar_binary(
          pair_spatial$place_id,
          event_value,
          pair_value,
          event_name,
          model
        ) |>
          dplyr::mutate(
            n_active_transition_points = nrow(pair_spatial),
            n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded =
              universe_row$n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded[[1]],
            analysis_universe =
              "active_transition_only_excluding_0to0"
          )

        transition_local_list[[transition_local_idx]] <- g_result
        transition_local_idx <- transition_local_idx + 1L

        # 補集合もactive地点内で定義する。
        # 0->0はすでに母集団から除外されているので補集合へ混入しない。
        complement_value <- 1L - event_value

        complement_result <- local_joincount_binary(
          pair_spatial$place_id,
          complement_value,
          pair_value,
          event_name,
          model,
          target_label = "non_event_complement",
          method_label = "local_join_count_complement"
        ) |>
          dplyr::mutate(
            n_active_transition_points = nrow(pair_spatial),
            n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded =
              universe_row$n_apparent_absence_continue_excluded[[1]],
            analysis_universe =
              "active_transition_only_excluding_0to0"
          )

        transition_local_list[[transition_local_idx]] <- complement_result
        transition_local_idx <- transition_local_idx + 1L
      }
    }
  }
}

spatial_transition_local_binary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  transition_local_list
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# C. QGIS向けprimary k
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
primary_lisa <- spatial_local_lisa |>
  dplyr::filter(
    k == spatial_primary_k
  )

primary_lisa_wide <- primary_lisa |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id,
    metric,
    local_moran_i,
    p_raw,
    p_bh,
    lisa_class_raw,
    lisa_class_bh
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = metric,
    values_from = c(
      local_moran_i,
      p_raw,
      p_bh,
      lisa_class_raw,
      lisa_class_bh
    ),
    names_glue = "{metric}_{.value}"
  )

spatial_continuity_gap_lisa_sf <- chronology_place_continuity_sf |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    primary_lisa_wide,
    by = "place_id"
  )

# inner_joinにすることで、0->0除外後のTransition空間分析対象地点だけを
# GPKGのTransition localレイヤへ出力する。
spatial_transition_local_binary_sf <- chronology_place_continuity_sf |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id
  ) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    spatial_transition_local_binary |>
      dplyr::filter(
        k == spatial_primary_k
      ),
    by = "place_id"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# D. CSV output
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
readr::write_csv(
  spatial_local_lisa,
  file.path(
    csv_dir,
    "spatial_local_moran_knn_sensitivity.csv"
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  spatial_transition_local_binary,
  file.path(
    csv_dir,
    "spatial_transition_local_binary.csv"
  )
)

print(
  spatial_local_lisa |>
    dplyr::count(
      k,
      metric,
      lisa_class_bh,
      name = "n_places"
    )
)

print(
  spatial_transition_local_binary |>
    dplyr::count(
      k,
      phase_pair,
      event_type,
      method,
      local_class_bh,
      name = "n_places"
    )
)
```

# 19. coordinate-aggregation-sensitivity

**目的**：異なる遺跡IDが同一座標を共有する場合について、別地点のまま扱うprimary modelと座標集約modelの差を評価する。

```{r c19_coordinate_aggregation_sensitivity, eval=TRUE}
spatial_base_df <- spatial_base_metric_sf |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

coordinate_aggregated_df <- spatial_base_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    coordinate_group_id,
    lon_value,
    lat_value
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_records = dplyr::n(),
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(available_spatial_metrics),
      ~ mean(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

coordinate_aggregated_sf <- coordinate_aggregated_df |>
  sf::st_as_sf(
    coords = c("lon_value", "lat_value"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  sf::st_transform(spatial_analysis_crs)

coords_agg <- sf::st_coordinates(coordinate_aggregated_sf)

aggregation_global_list <- list()
aggregation_local_summary_list <- list()

for (k_value in spatial_k_values) {
  k_eff <- min(k_value, nrow(coordinate_aggregated_sf) - 1L)
  nb_agg <- build_symmetric_knn_nb(coords_agg, k_eff)
  listw_agg <- spdep::nb2listw(nb_agg, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
  model_id <- paste0("coordinate_aggregated_knn_k", k_eff)

  aggregation_global_list[[as.character(k_value)]] <- purrr::map_dfr(
    available_spatial_metrics,
    function(metric_name) {
      global_moran_one(
        coordinate_aggregated_sf[[metric_name]],
        metric_name,
        listw_agg,
        model_id
      ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(k = k_eff, coordinate_policy = "aggregated")
    }
  )

  if (k_eff == spatial_primary_k) {
    aggregation_local <- purrr::map_dfr(
      available_spatial_metrics,
      function(metric_name) {
        local_moran_one(
          coordinate_aggregated_sf$coordinate_group_id,
          coordinate_aggregated_sf[[metric_name]],
          metric_name,
          listw_agg,
          model_id,
          k_eff
        )
      }
    )

    aggregation_local_summary_list[[as.character(k_value)]] <- aggregation_local |>
      dplyr::count(metric, lisa_class_bh, name = "n_nodes") |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        coordinate_policy = "aggregated",
        k = k_eff
      )
  }
}

spatial_coordinate_aggregation_global <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  aggregation_global_list
)

separate_global_for_comparison <- spatial_global_moran |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    coordinate_policy = "separate_records",
    k = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(model_id, "[0-9]+$"))
  )

spatial_coordinate_aggregation_sensitivity <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  separate_global_for_comparison,
  spatial_coordinate_aggregation_global
) |>
  dplyr::select(
    coordinate_policy,
    k,
    metric,
    n_points,
    moran_i,
    p_value,
    dplyr::everything()
  )

separate_local_primary_summary <- spatial_local_lisa |>
  dplyr::filter(k == spatial_primary_k) |>
  dplyr::count(metric, lisa_class_bh, name = "n_nodes") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    coordinate_policy = "separate_records",
    k = spatial_primary_k
  )

spatial_coordinate_aggregation_local_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  separate_local_primary_summary,
  dplyr::bind_rows(aggregation_local_summary_list)
)

readr::write_csv(
  spatial_coordinate_aggregation_sensitivity,
  file.path(csv_dir, "spatial_coordinate_aggregation_sensitivity.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  spatial_coordinate_aggregation_local_summary,
  file.path(csv_dir, "spatial_coordinate_aggregation_local_summary.csv")
)

print(spatial_coordinate_aggregation_sensitivity)
```

# 22. export-gpkg-and-metadata

**目的**：QGIS用の分析結果をGPKGへ出力する。Transitionについては0→0除外後の時期ペア別kNN edgeと局所分析結果を別レイヤで保存し、分析日時・Rmdバージョン・パラメータ・入力由来情報も属性テーブルとして保存する。

```{r c22_export_gpkg_and_metadata, eval=TRUE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. continuity / gap primary k edge geometry
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
primary_edges <- spatial_neighbor_edges |>
  dplyr::filter(
    k == spatial_primary_k
  )

if (nrow(primary_edges) > 0) {
  primary_edge_geometry <- sf::st_sfc(
    lapply(
      seq_len(nrow(primary_edges)),
      function(i) {
        sf::st_linestring(
          rbind(
            coords_metric[
              primary_edges$from_index[i],
              ,
              drop = FALSE
            ],
            coords_metric[
              primary_edges$to_index[i],
              ,
              drop = FALSE
            ]
          )
        )
      }
    ),
    crs = spatial_analysis_crs
  )

  spatial_neighbor_edges_primary_sf <- sf::st_sf(
    primary_edges,
    geometry = primary_edge_geometry
  ) |>
    sf::st_transform(4326)

} else {
  spatial_neighbor_edges_primary_sf <- make_empty_point_sf()
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. Transition primary k edge geometry
#
# Transitionは各時期ペアのactive地点だけからkNNを再構築しているため、
# 通常の全地点kNN edgeとは別レイヤとして出力する。
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
primary_transition_edges <- spatial_transition_neighbor_edges |>
  dplyr::filter(
    k == spatial_primary_k
  )

spatial_point_xy_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
  place_id = spatial_base_metric_sf$place_id,
  x_metric = coords_metric[, 1],
  y_metric = coords_metric[, 2]
)

primary_transition_edges_xy <- primary_transition_edges |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    spatial_point_xy_lookup |>
      dplyr::rename(
        from_place_id = place_id,
        from_x = x_metric,
        from_y = y_metric
      ),
    by = "from_place_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    spatial_point_xy_lookup |>
      dplyr::rename(
        to_place_id = place_id,
        to_x = x_metric,
        to_y = y_metric
      ),
    by = "to_place_id"
  )

if (nrow(primary_transition_edges_xy) > 0) {
  if (
    any(
      !is.finite(primary_transition_edges_xy$from_x) |
        !is.finite(primary_transition_edges_xy$from_y) |
        !is.finite(primary_transition_edges_xy$to_x) |
        !is.finite(primary_transition_edges_xy$to_y)
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      "Transition kNN edgeのgeometry生成に必要な座標が見つかりません。"
    )
  }

  primary_transition_edge_geometry <- sf::st_sfc(
    lapply(
      seq_len(nrow(primary_transition_edges_xy)),
      function(i) {
        sf::st_linestring(
          matrix(
            c(
              primary_transition_edges_xy$from_x[i],
              primary_transition_edges_xy$from_y[i],
              primary_transition_edges_xy$to_x[i],
              primary_transition_edges_xy$to_y[i]
            ),
            ncol = 2,
            byrow = TRUE
          )
        )
      }
    ),
    crs = spatial_analysis_crs
  )

  spatial_transition_neighbor_edges_primary_sf <- sf::st_sf(
    primary_transition_edges_xy,
    geometry = primary_transition_edge_geometry
  ) |>
    sf::st_transform(4326)

} else {
  spatial_transition_neighbor_edges_primary_sf <- make_empty_point_sf()
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# C. coordinate groups
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
coordinate_group_sf <- coordinate_group_summary |>
  sf::st_as_sf(
    coords = c(
      "lon_value",
      "lat_value"
    ),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# D. activity-domain spatial layers for QGIS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
activity_domain_metrics_sf <- chronology_place_continuity_sf |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id
  ) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    activity_domain_place_metrics,
    by = "place_id"
  )

activity_domain_phase_presence_sf <- chronology_place_continuity_sf |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id
  ) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    place_phase_activity_long |>
      dplyr::filter(
        activity_domain == "all_land_use" |
          presence == 1L |
          is.na(presence)
      ),
    by = "place_id"
  )

# confirmed active transitionとtemporally_unresolved transitionを
# QGISで区別して確認できるようにする。
activity_domain_transition_sf <- chronology_place_continuity_sf |>
  dplyr::select(
    place_id
  ) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    activity_domain_transition_long |>
      dplyr::filter(
        activity_domain != "all_land_use",
        transition %in% transition_levels |
          transition_resolution == "temporally_unresolved"
      ),
    by = "place_id"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# E. GPKG spatial layers
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
gpkg_written <- c(
  chronology_place_continuity = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    chronology_place_continuity_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    "chronology_place_continuity"
  ),

  chronology_place_phase_presence = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    chronology_place_phase_presence_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    "chronology_place_phase_presence"
  ),

  chronology_phase_transition = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    chronology_phase_transition_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    "chronology_phase_transition"
  ),

  chronology_run_events = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    chronology_run_events_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    "chronology_run_events"
  ),

  chronology_gap_events = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    chronology_gap_events_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    "chronology_gap_events"
  ),

  coordinate_groups = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    coordinate_group_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    "coordinate_groups"
  ),

  activity_domain_place_metrics = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    activity_domain_metrics_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    "activity_domain_place_metrics"
  ),

  activity_domain_phase_presence = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    activity_domain_phase_presence_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    "activity_domain_phase_presence"
  ),

  activity_domain_transition = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    activity_domain_transition_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    "activity_domain_transition"
  ),

  spatial_knn_edges_primary = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    spatial_neighbor_edges_primary_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    paste0(
      "spatial_knn_edges_k",
      spatial_primary_k
    )
  ),

  spatial_transition_knn_edges_primary = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    spatial_transition_neighbor_edges_primary_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    paste0(
      "spatial_transition_knn_edges_k",
      spatial_primary_k
    )
  ),

  spatial_local_moran_primary = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    spatial_continuity_gap_lisa_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    paste0(
      "spatial_local_moran_k",
      spatial_primary_k
    )
  ),

  spatial_transition_local_primary = write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    spatial_transition_local_binary_sf,
    continuity_gpkg,
    paste0(
      "spatial_transition_local_k",
      spatial_primary_k
    )
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# F. GPKG metadata / parameter tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
input_md5 <- unname(
  tools::md5sum(
    input_csv
  )
)

analysis_metadata <- tibble::tibble(
  run_id = analysis_run_id,
  analysis_datetime_utc = analysis_datetime_utc,
  analysis_version = analysis_version,
  input_filename = basename(input_csv),
  input_md5 = input_md5,
  n_input_rows = nrow(chronology_input_all),
  n_analysis_rows = nrow(chronology_raw),
  phase_definition = paste(
    phase_cols,
    collapse = "->"
  ),
  time_weighting = "not_used",
  activity_domain_policy =
    "Tokyo activity preprocessing v1.3; phase-specific flags preserve temporally_unresolved as NA; unresolved states are excluded from phase/pair denominators and unresolved full sequences are excluded from Run/Gap metrics",
  coordinate_policy_primary =
    "separate_records_original_coordinates",
  coordinate_policy_sensitivity =
    "aggregate_exact_same_coordinates",
  transition_spatial_universe_policy =
    "exclude apparent_absence_continue (0->0) within each phase pair; rebuild neighbors within active transition points",
  map_rendering_policy =
    "QGIS; no geometry jitter"
)

analysis_parameters <- tibble::tibble(
  parameter = c(
    "baseline_weight_set",
    "cluster_k_candidates",
    "selected_cluster_k",
    "cluster_stability_repeats",
    "landscape_min_places",
    "spatial_analysis_crs",
    "spatial_k_values",
    "spatial_primary_k",
    "spatial_alpha",
    "spatial_permutations",
    "run_fixed_distance_calibration",
    "fixed_distance_bands_m",
    "local_p_adjustment",
    "transition_spatial_universe",
    "transition_neighbors_rebuilt_by_phase_pair",
    "activity_temporally_unresolved_policy",
    "activity_run_gap_resolution_policy"
  ),
  value = c(
    baseline_weight_set,
    paste(
      cluster_k_candidates,
      collapse = ","
    ),
    as.character(selected_cluster_k),
    as.character(cluster_stability_repeats),
    as.character(landscape_min_places),
    as.character(spatial_analysis_crs),
    paste(
      spatial_k_values,
      collapse = ","
    ),
    as.character(spatial_primary_k),
    as.character(spatial_alpha),
    as.character(spatial_permutations),
    as.character(run_fixed_distance_calibration),
    paste(
      fixed_distance_bands_m,
      collapse = ","
    ),
    "BH",
    "active_transition_only_excluding_0to0",
    "TRUE",
    "preserve_as_NA_and_exclude_from_phase_pair_denominators",
    "exclude_place_domain_sequence_if_any_phase_is_temporally_unresolved"
  )
)

input_provenance <- tibble::tibble(
  source_group = c(
    "input",
    "GSI_landform",
    "W07_watershed"
  ),
  source_id = c(
    basename(input_csv),

    if (
      "gsi_landform_source" %in%
        names(chronology_raw)
    ) {
      paste(
        unique(
          stats::na.omit(
            chronology_raw$gsi_landform_source
          )
        ),
        collapse = ";"
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },

    if (
      "w07_source_id" %in%
        names(chronology_raw)
    ) {
      paste(
        unique(
          stats::na.omit(
            chronology_raw$w07_source_id
          )
        ),
        collapse = ";"
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  ),

  source_detail = c(
    input_md5,

    if (
      "gsi_landform_zoom" %in%
        names(chronology_raw)
    ) {
      paste0(
        "zoom=",
        paste(
          unique(
            stats::na.omit(
              chronology_raw$gsi_landform_zoom
            )
          ),
          collapse = ";"
        )
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },

    if (
      "w07_source_year" %in%
        names(chronology_raw)
    ) {
      paste0(
        "year=",
        paste(
          unique(
            stats::na.omit(
              chronology_raw$w07_source_year
            )
          ),
          collapse = ";"
        )
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  )
)

spatial_model_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  spatial_neighbor_diagnostics |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model_family =
        "knn_all_spatial_points"
    ),

  spatial_transition_neighbor_diagnostics |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model_family =
        "transition_knn_active_only"
    ),

  fixed_distance_neighbor_diagnostics |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model_family =
        "fixed_distance_all_spatial_points"
    )
)

write_gpkg_attribute_table(
  analysis_metadata,
  continuity_gpkg,
  "analysis_metadata",
  "Analysis run metadata"
)

write_gpkg_attribute_table(
  analysis_parameters,
  continuity_gpkg,
  "analysis_parameters",
  "Analysis parameter set"
)

write_gpkg_attribute_table(
  input_provenance,
  continuity_gpkg,
  "input_provenance",
  "Input and environmental-data provenance"
)

write_gpkg_attribute_table(
  spatial_model_diagnostics,
  continuity_gpkg,
  "spatial_model_diagnostics",
  "Spatial-neighbour diagnostics"
)

readr::write_csv(
  analysis_metadata,
  file.path(
    csv_dir,
    "analysis_metadata.csv"
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  analysis_parameters,
  file.path(
    csv_dir,
    "analysis_parameters.csv"
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  input_provenance,
  file.path(
    csv_dir,
    "input_provenance.csv"
  )
)

print(gpkg_written)
cat(
  "GPKG written:",
  continuity_gpkg,
  "\n"
)
```
